structured_output.what_is_happening: Stockdrip is a pump.fun coin, still on its bonding curve and about 40 minutes old. Its pitch is paying holders in tokenized stocks (NVDAx, AAPLx, SPYx) bought with creator fees. It rose about 326% within its first hour and peaked near $46k market cap (ATH price 4.61e-5). It met the rule during a sharp crash: price was -50% to -68% over the last 5 minutes, and market cap was about $16k at detection and $14k at collection, roughly 70% below the peak. The creator's balance is 0 and GMGN marks the creator as 'creator_close', so the dev has already exited. A community takeover (CTO) flag is set. GMGN tags 163 of 253 traders as bundlers and 231 as fresh wallets. The curve is at 61 of about 115 virtual SOL.

narrative.description: The pitch is a 'dividend coin' that drips tokenized US stocks (xStocks) to holders every 5 minutes, funded by pump.fun creator fees. It is a fairly novel mechanic that combines reflection or reward tokens with the RWA / tokenized-stocks theme. It comes with a dedicated website and an X account that has no rename history.
narrative.why_spreading: The first-hour pump looks mostly driven by bundlers and fresh wallets, not organic spread. The dev has already exited, which breaks the promise that creator fees will buy stocks. Unless the CTO keeps the drip running, the story has nothing behind it. There is no X data to confirm organic attention.

token_connection.why_this_token: This is the pair listed with the project's website and X handle, and it has almost all the volume. The DexScreener profile is present.
token_connection.competing_tokens: One copycat with the same name (29b2...pump) was created about 4 minutes later and is effectively dead: $3.4k market cap, $228 of hourly volume.

authenticity.evidence: 163 of 253 GMGN-tagged traders are bundlers and 231 are fresh wallets. The creator already closed their position. The coin peaked at about $46k and is now crashing 50-68% in 5 minutes. There are no paid DexScreener boosts, 0 smart-money signals, 0 KOL wallets, and only 61 GMGN page visits.
authenticity.uncertainty: The top-10 holders own only 17.6%, and the top bundler holds about 9% of trader volume, so current concentration is not extreme. Nine wallets are tagged smart. The CTO could be genuine community interest.

structural_risks: The dev has already sold (creator_close), and the CTO leaves it unclear who will fund the stock drip
Heavy bundler/fresh-wallet activity suggests a coordinated launch that is now being distributed
Price is in a fast crash, about 70% below the ATH, with more unique sellers than buyers in the last 5 minutes
On the bonding curve, a 2x needs the coin to climb back toward the prior ATH area, about $28k+ market cap, against bag holders from the top
Pump.fun coins that stall at half the curve usually bleed out

structured_output.counterargument: The narrative is unusual and marketable: a pump.fun coin that pays out real tokenized stocks. Holders are fairly spread out (top 10 at 17.6%, 873 holders), and there are 9 smart wallets and a CTO. At $14k market cap, a crash flush followed by a narrative-driven second wave could easily reach 2x ($28k), which is still below the $46k ATH. Pump.fun coins often retrace sharply in the first hour and then run again once weak hands are gone.
unknowns: Whether the stock-drip mechanic actually works and who pays for it now that the creator has exited
How much of the bundled supply remains to be sold

structured_output.thesis: This is a bundled pump.fun launch with a clever tokenized-stock dividend pitch. The dev has already exited, and the rule fired during a 50-68% five-minute crash from a roughly $46k ATH. The most likely path is a continued bleed on the curve, possibly with small bounces. A 2x from entry would need a real second wave that none of the signals show yet.
